P1: The Viridian Gym has no type specialty, as 青绿 prefers to use the same Pokémon from his time as Champion.
P2: The Gym features a maze of spinner tiles to disorient any challengers. As in the Blackthorn Gym, the unstable floor forces any Pokémon accompanying you back into its Poké Ball. Begin by stepping on the southern-most red tile along the east wall; this leads to a stopper tile a short distance to the northwest. Move two steps westward to the next red tile to reach the second stopper tile. Walk two steps north to the next red tile, then step on the next red tile to the northeast. Move two steps eastward to reach the northeastern-most stopper tile, then two steps eastward again to reach the Gym Leader.
P3: As 青绿's team is more diverse than those of other Gym Leaders, defeating him will not be as easy. 电 attacks fare well against his 大比鸟 and 暴鲤龙, while they—and 风速狗—are also vulnerable to 岩石 moves. 虫-, 幽灵-, and 恶 moves are effective against his 椰蛋树. His 怪力 fares poorly against 超能力- and 飞行 moves. 水 attacks are best against both his 钻角犀兽 and Arcanine. Blue's team has access to powerful attacks, so use healing items often and switch Pokémon out as necessary to keep up the pressure.
P4: After the battle, 青绿 awards you the 绿色徽章, the sixteenth and final Badge. He also hands out 招式学习器92（戏法空间） as a prize.
P5: When you exit the Gym, you receive a call from Professor Oak. He knows how hard that you have been working, and decided to get you something to show his appreciation. He ends the call by inviting you to stop by his lab to pick it up.
P6: Return to 真新镇 and meet with Professor Oak to receive his gift: 秘传学习器08（攀岩）. This field move allows a Pokémon to carry its Trainer up rock walls wherever steps have been carved into them. Seeing that you have earned all eight Kanto Badges as well, he makes arrangements for you to visit 白银山, a large mountain to the west of 石英高原 that only the strongest Trainers are allowed to reach because of the powerful wild Pokémon found inside.
P7: 22号道路 is a simple route that connects 常青市 back to the Pokémon League Reception Gate in the west.
P8: Thanks to Professor Oak, it is now possible to venture westward to 白银山. The guards that had blocked off the two side hallways have stepped aside, allowing Trainers to travel between Johto and Kanto on foot, without the need for the Magnet Train or the S.S. Aqua.
P9: 28号道路 is a hidden mountain road in western Kanto. The path leads westward from the Pokémon League Reception Gate and crosses into Johto at the entrance to 白银山.
D1: From the woman in the house, accessed via Mt. Silver Exterior (requires 居合斩)
D2: East of the reclusive Idol's house, accessed via Mt. Silver Exterior (requires 居合斩)
D3: End of the dead-end path east of the house (hidden; requires 居合斩)
P10: The uneven terrain forces travelers to pass by the entrance to 白银山 in order to reach the route's northern area. Use 居合斩 to clear a path and visit the house on the hill. The woman inside is a retired Idol, and the celebrity now lives a quiet life in order to protect her privacy. She gives you 招式学习器47（钢翼） in the hope that you will keep her hideaway a secret.
P11: The uneven road from 28号道路 leads directly to a Pokémon Center at the foot of the mountain. This gives anyone attempting to scale the mountain one last opportunity to make preparations. 冲浪, 碎岩, 攀瀑, and 攀岩 are required to fully explore the hallowed mountain.
D4: East of the Pokémon Center, above a ledge (hidden)
D5: On the southwest hill (requires 冲浪)
